title: Recording review index (GET /recordings/review, f1c.recordings.review/1, api_version 10)
description: State of the review index of one closed recording, named by session=<review_id>. state none: not built yet (ask again); building: the viewer polls again; ready: laps and cars are indexed (reason is set when a bad block ended a valid prefix); error: nothing usable (reason). lap_len is null until the META block carries it (R1-B). Nothing here is a file path.
